name: Snack Condiments
description: Independent, complete Condiments for the Snack desktop operating environment.

condiments.name: Wallpaper
condiments.description: Give any Snack a background image. Fill, fit or stretch it without changing its source.

agent.instructions: Wallpaper is entirely implemented by this external Condiment. Discover condiment-agent-guide to read its command schemas. Open it with condiment-open if necessary, then use condiment-command with this Condiment id and command apply (snackId, managed mediaId, fit cover/contain/stretch) or remove (snackId). Its commands call generic presentation tools; Snack has no Wallpaper-specific code. Upload chosen images with media-begin/media-chunk/media-finish. Verify presentation-state for the target Snack. Use only the user’s requested target and current permissions.

skills.name: snack-wallpaper
skills.description: Apply or remove a wallpaper on a selected Snack.

commands.name: apply
commands.description: Apply this Condiment’s wallpaper to a Snack.

condiments.name: Simple Agent Chat
condiments.description: Chat with one or several agents. Share files, reply, react and make things happen in Snack.

agent.instructions: This is a shared human/agent conversation surface. Discover chat-inbox for messages addressed to your authenticated agent id. Use chat-read for room context, then chat-send with roomId, text, recipients and optional replyTo; sender identity is enforced by Snack. Other selected agents may be recipients. Never enter an unbounded reply loop. chat-react toggles a reaction. chat-file reads shared attachments in chunks; chat-file-inspect extracts text/PDF/Office/ZIP content. Audio and video are shared files; only claim interpretation your runtime supports. Use current Snack API/MCP actions to perform the user’s task. Do not assume an inbox connection automatically generates replies. Optional Condiment guides and skills are available through condiment-agent-guide and can be shared by the user. They do not grant additional permissions.

skills.name: snack-group-chat
skills.description: Participate in a human/agent/agent Snack conversation with replies, attachments and reactions.
